judge_items.criterion: 真实立体环绕、前后遮挡交换、落位/回弹与地面接触自然；光点沿环运行，连续动作不是模板贴图或不连贯跳变。

rating_anchors.0: 无落位/完整环绕或前后关系错误；明显跳变、穿模使核心叙事失效。
rating_anchors.0.5: 核心环绕、遮挡和接触成立，但回弹、加减速或轨迹有可见生硬。
rating_anchors.1: 完整环绕和遮挡交换清楚，落位/回弹可信，运动连续流畅。

judge_items.criterion: 两种画幅主动布局，产品与轨道有视觉主次、文案可读、预留UI区不被重要内容占据；同一动作在双版一致。

rating_anchors.0: 任一版核心内容不可读/被UI区遮蔽，或未形成可用双端布局。
rating_anchors.0.5: 两版内容可辨且主要区域正确，但字号、留白、视觉主次之一明显弱。
rating_anchors.1: 两版构图主动适配，产品、轨道、品牌清楚且层级合理，预留区可直接使用。

judge_items.criterion: 主落位冲击对应实际接触，品牌双音对应文案出现；不把早期弱装饰音当落位，整体声音自然。

rating_anchors.0: 实际声音缺失/错位，或主接触、品牌关键对应关系错误。
rating_anchors.0.5: 两个主要时刻对应成立，但冲击感、衔接或整体响度不自然。
rating_anchors.1: 接触和品牌提示清晰同步，装饰音不喧宾夺主，声音完整无削波或突兀断裂。

judge_items.criterion: 真实扫描相机辨识度、材质与光影有广告完成度，运动曲线、收尾与字体层级清楚，无闪烁、穿模或明显采样损伤。

rating_anchors.0: 无法辨识产品或成片明显损坏，持续闪烁/采样故障/严重材质问题。
rating_anchors.0.5: 产品可辨且可播放，材质/灯光/字体/采样至少一项有明显欠缺。
rating_anchors.1: 产品材质、灯光、字体和收尾有一致完成度，未见影响观看的渲染或采样缺陷。

hard_constraints.audio: 48kHz stereo; supplied cue_track retained at original timing
hard_constraints.body_geometry: same protected mesh and local transform, no shape keys/deforming modifiers
hard_constraints.contact: first contact within 2 frames of main low-frequency cue; no penetration >0.003; settled within 12 frames after cue
hard_constraints.turn: PRODUCT_ROOT rotation_z total range >=0.40 radians before brand reveal, final 40 frames stable within0.01rad
hard_constraints.orbit: TRACER traces >=300deg before brand reveal, stays on HALO tube centerline within0.025; each camera sees >=30 visible and >=5 product-occluded frames before brand reveal
hard_constraints.layout: bbox projection inside public safe rectangles with tolerance0.01; body projected bbox area >=0.045; text same strings and visible at brand cue±2frames through end
hard_constraints.rebuild: six deterministic project-hash-selected full-resolution reconstruction frames, correlation>=0.94 and mean RGB absolute error<=0.08; accent color edit changes visible pixels
hard_constraints.project: packed, no movie/sequence textures, autoexec disabled, same object datablocks across scenes
hard_constraints.accent_probe: Change Principled Base Color to cyan (0.02,0.8,0.95); at least40 rendered pixels must change by >20/255 in any RGB channel.
hard_constraints.engineering: No object/scene/material drivers or external libraries; no animation directly on PRODUCT_BODY; no modifiers or shape keys on protected body, HALO or TRACER. Root/HALO/TRACER scale1. PLINTH top fixed at world z0±0.003. HALO/TRACER visible and actual mesh surfaces must match specified torus/sphere sizes within0.002.
hard_constraints.contact_definition: Contact gap uses transformed body bounding-box minimum z minus evaluated PLINTH top; gap<=0.003 counts as contact; post-settle absolute gap<=0.003. Tracer nearest-surface distance must be>=0.052.
hard_constraints.ray_definition: Visibility/occlusion uses first scene ray hit towards TRACER center. Body first = product-occluded; TRACER first = visible. Counts apply before true brand cue.

anchors.automatic: Binary group gates; no interpolation. Exact tolerances appear in hard_constraints.

unverified: missing judge/API or environment failure => formal_total=null; known hard failure =>accepted=false
automatic_scoring: Each automatic group receives its stated weight only if every implemented gate in that group passes; otherwise zero. Metrics are reported separately.
